issues.on_page: Other Support Services 233,808 (Activities Fund 136,070 + Depreciation 41,200 + Employee Benefit 48,561 + Student Fee 7,977)
issues.issue: Activities Fund spending (136,070, 58%) is the largest part of this line, and detail records it as student activities. Keeping the printed function (code 2900, support services) is defensible, but under the 'dominant category' rule this could be student activities. Notes don't mention the mix.

issues.issue: The typed Statement of Activities figures don't agree with the fund statement (p13, 286,101) and were corrected by hand. This is only mentioned in notes, not in report_discrepancies. The extraction uses the p13 figure, which ties.

Label mixes fines and licenses. Fines is the likely dominant part for a school district, but the rule asks for a review note naming the mix, and none was added (same for detail lines with codes 1911/2110).
